title: Hands holding three green cylindrical molds on a worn compression press bed
objects_and_counts: One person is partially visible: both forearms and both hands are seen holding the objects (center-left to center of image); the person's head and torso are not visible.
Three green cylindrical molds (plastic appearance) are clustered together on the press bed at the center of the image; all three are visible and not fully obscured.
Two vertical threaded rods/bolts are visible as part of the press assembly: one in the front left of the cluster (slightly corroded/paint-chipped) and one rear-right behind the molds.
One large rectangular metal plate (press bed) occupies the lower and central portion of the image; the plate shows chipping paint, dirt and wear.
One control box or machine panel is visible at the far left edge of the image (partially cropped), with stickers/labels affixed to it.
One white tile wall with stains and splatter is visible in the background behind the press bed.

The control box or machine panel is located at the far left edge of the image, behind the press bed; the tiled wall is behind the entire assembly and runs along the top background.
The press bed occupies the lower two-thirds of the image with the molds centered on a slightly raised rectangular section of the bed.
